# n8n_tag (Data Source)

Looks up a single n8n global tag by id via `GET /api/v1/tags/{id}`.

Returns registry metadata only (`name`, timestamps). This does not describe which workflows use the tag.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "n8n_tag" "example" {
  id = n8n_tag.example.id
}

resource "n8n_tag" "example" {
  name              = "production"
  delete_protection = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Tag ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp from n8n.
- `name` (String) Tag name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp from n8n.
